messages:
marie (partnerships): Quick check — Snowflake + Qdrant field trial schedule. Can we align connector cert, marketplace listing, and the hardware partner pilot announcement? Need rough dates for comms and a sync with partner.

alex (eng): QA run finishes next Tue. Perf validation for long-tail queries will take ~48h after that.

jordan (product): If QA ends Tue, can we aim for a marketplace canary Wed and a public announcement two weeks after? Need legal signoff + customer opt-in checklist.

tess (commops): Two-week embargo sounds fine. We should draft joint blog + co-branded press. Scheduling a 30m with partner comms. @sam can you flag any IP/marketing approvals we should expect?

sam (legal): Quick flag: partner requests logo usage + quote clearance — we need written approval within 4 business days. Also run an export-control check on the edge hardware config.

alex (eng): Heads up — hardware partner needs model quantization profile docs. I'll upload baseline perf numbers to the partner bucket: s3://redwood-partners/snow-qdrant-trial/benchmarks.csv

marketplace-bot: Marketplace checklist updated: cert_publication_ready=false, security_review=pending

marie (partnerships): Action items: (1) Alex produce quant profile + perf CSV by Tue EOD; (2) Sam draft logo/quote approval template by Fri; (3) Tess draft comms timeline and request partner comms dates; (4) Jordan own marketplace canary. I'll sync with partner Wed 10am PT. :calendar: 

alex (eng): On it. If we need to validate burst throughput we may spin a small canary instance — ping me.

tess (commops): Added Wed 10am PT to calendar and invited partner reps. Draft blog outline in drive: https://drive.redwood.com/partnerships/snow-qdrant/blog-outline

jordan (product): One more ask: can we include a short demo notebook for marketplace customers? If yes, I'll add it to the asset bundle.

marie (partnerships): Yes — demo notebook great. Alex + Jordan to coordinate. Closing the loop after Wed sync.
